title: Select and implement build-time styling, atomic compilers, and variant APIs safely

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-brand design system and Next.js App Router product UI

prompt: Choose a zero-runtime styling and variant architecture for our multi-brand Next.js App Router design system, avoiding RSC pitfalls and silent CSS extraction failures.
forbiddenBehaviors: recommends runtime Emotion or styled-components for greenfield React Server Components without flagging RSC and SSR overhead
passes runtime template literals or object spreads into Panda CSS css() calls
mixes default exports or components into StyleX *.stylex.ts defineVars files

rubricDimensions.pass: selects a build-time RSC-safe model (CSS Modules, Tailwind v4, Panda CSS, vanilla-extract, StyleX, or UnoCSS) and explains theme contract trade-offs
rubricDimensions.fail: defaults to runtime CSS-in-JS for RSC or stacks competing styling frameworks without @layer migration boundaries

rubricDimensions.pass: respects tool-specific compiler constraints (Panda literal tokens/sva/staticCss, vanilla-extract createThemeContract/assignInlineVars, StyleX *.stylex.ts named-only exports, UnoCSS safelist)
rubricDimensions.fail: writes dynamic expressions that emit class names with no generated CSS

rubricDimensions.pass: uses typed variant APIs (CVA + tailwind-merge, tailwind-variants tv/slots, Panda sva, or vanilla-extract recipes) with deterministic override behavior
rubricDimensions.fail: concatenates conflicting utility classes without merge resolution

negativeControls.name: panda dynamic template literal
negativeControls.input: use css({ color: `red.${shade}` }) in Panda CSS
negativeControls.mustNot: approve dynamic template literals inside Panda css() calls

negativeControls.name: stylex invalid token file exports
negativeControls.input: export default colors and a React component from tokens.stylex.ts
negativeControls.mustNot: allow default exports or non-var exports inside *.stylex.ts files

baseline.withoutSkill: picks runtime CSS-in-JS in RSC or writes dynamic Panda/UnoCSS strings that silently drop CSS in production
baseline.withSkill: chooses an RSC-safe build-time styling system, follows static extraction and theme-contract rules, and resolves variant overrides deterministically
